> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **215** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **155** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **155**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **100** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **136** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 2bbb462335ad617f51ba7fc1a0c872f932f47513` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `75eb534af0878f97da34b6d195b9db7a0946788a` — the merge of head `27704f4cc2d7b6b06b17fcd053d330270345bf7d` into base `2bbb462335ad617f51ba7fc1a0c872f932f47513`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 75eb534af0878f97da34b6d195b9db7a0946788a && git checkout 75eb534af0878f97da34b6d195b9db7a0946788a
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 2bbb462335ad617f51ba7fc1a0c872f932f47513 27704f4cc2d7b6b06b17fcd053d330270345bf7d && git checkout -B drift-repro 2bbb462335ad617f51ba7fc1a0c872f932f47513 && git merge --no-ff 27704f4cc2d7b6b06b17fcd053d330270345bf7d

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 2bbb462335ad617f51ba7fc1a0c872f932f47513
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 2bbb462335ad617f51ba7fc1a0c872f932f47513` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: 45/45 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `27704f4cc2d7b6b06b17fcd053d330270345bf7d`

Isolated at-tier reviewer subagent, run by the `domain:spec` seat-4 session on the maintainer's instruction in that session (「帮我处理」, with the landing route chosen there); every one of its 45 transcript turns served at the tier the constant names. Adopted by the seat 2026-09-24T05:35Z. The record below is the reviewer's, unedited except the two header lines.


### ① Derived judgments

1. **Accept set: unchanged — right.** `git show origin/main:packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.zod.ts | grep -n 'a-z0-9_\]{1,19}'` prints `390: .regex(/^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,19}$/, ...)`; the same command on `refs/review/pr-19869` prints `391:` with the byte-identical regex. `packages/spec/src/marketplace/package.zod.ts` likewise: `origin/main:202` and `refs/review/pr-19869:203`, same regex. The diff (`pulls/19869`, Accept diff, 162 lines) touches only message strings, comments, TSDoc, tests and one changeset. Direct probe of the regex (`node probe.mjs` in scratch): `1leave`, `_leave`, `a`, 21 chars, `Leave`, `le-ave`, `le.ave`, non-ascii, trailing space → REFUSE; `leave`, `ab`, `a1`, `a_`, `my_app_2`, `crm`, 20 chars → ACCEPT. The card asks for no accept-set change and none is made.

2. **Refusal sentence is TRUE — right.** `refs/review/pr-19869:packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.zod.ts:391`: `Namespace must be 2-20 chars, start with a lowercase letter, and contain only lowercase letters, digits and underscores`. Clause by clause against `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,19}$`: `[a-z]` first = start with a lowercase letter (leading digit and leading underscore refused, probe above); `[a-z0-9_]{1,19}` = 1..19 more from exactly lowercase letters, digits, underscore (hyphen, dot, uppercase, non-ascii, whitespace refused); 1 + 1..19 = 2-20 chars. No clause admits a value the regex refuses and the regex refuses nothing the sentence admits. This is the shape the card suggested.

3. **TSDoc `Rules:` line — right.** `refs/review/pr-19869:packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.zod.ts:382-383`: `2-20 characters, starting with a lowercase letter; lowercase letters, digits, and underscores only (`1leave` and `_leave` are refused).` States the same rule as the refusal; the two examples are exactly the card's.

4. **`PackageSchema.namespace` sentence and its two derived fields — right, and inside the amended claim.** `refs/review/pr-19869:packages/spec/src/marketplace/package.zod.ts:203` carries the byte-identical new sentence; lines 198-202 now say the SENTENCE is kept identical, not only the pattern. `package.zod.ts:296` `namespace: PackageSchema.shape.namespace` (CreatePackageRequestSchema) and `template-manifest.zod.ts:106` `namespace: CreatePackageRequestSchema.shape.namespace.describe(...)` (TemplateManifestSchema) inherit it, so all four fields read one refusal. Triage comment 5793132438 required both copies to move together; amendment comment 5796198185 puts this file and its test in the claim surface.

5. **Generated docs and `.describe()` — right.** Neither `.describe()` text changed; the generated `refs/review/pr-19869:content/docs/references/kernel/manifest.mdx:31` renders the describe text only and states no charset rule, so there is nothing to regenerate. `git grep -l -i -E 'Namespace must be|alphanumeric \+ underscore' refs/review/pr-19869 -- 'content/docs/references/**' '**/*.json' '**/*.mdx'` → zero hits. `Lint & Repo Gates` and `Spec property liveness` check-runs at head: success.

6. **Every copy of the rule now says the same thing — right.** `git grep -F 'lowercase alphanumeric + underscore' refs/review/pr-19869` → only `.changeset/19577-duplicate-package-explicit-namespace.md:15` and the PR's own changeset line 11 (as the "was" quote). Remaining restatements all name the leading letter or quote the regex: `packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts:86-88` docblock and `:473-474` refusal (`a lowercase letter followed by lowercase letters, digits or underscores`); `packages/spec/src/api/endpoint-publish-gate.ts:181`, `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts:58`, `packages/create-objectstack/src/index.ts:98`, `content/docs/api/declarative-endpoints.mdx:124-125`, `docs/adr/0048:426`, `docs/adr/0121:170` quote the regex; `package-namespace.test.ts:55-56` docblock states the leading letter. `packages/spec/src/kernel/namespace-prefix.ts:17` says `(2-20 chars)` in an internal comment above the regex, and its emitted messages (`:37`, `:40`) state no charset rule, so no author-facing copy is left incomplete. `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md:155` states no charset rule. The four docs flagged by the drift-check comment (5796149365) contain no charset statement (`git grep -i namespace` on each, filtered for char/lower/letter/digit/underscore/regex/must: only `quick-reference.mdx:311`, which is about explicit declaration, not charset).

7. **Doors that surface the sentence — right.** `refs/review/pr-19869:packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:19399-19405`: `ManifestSchema.shape.namespace.safeParse(...)`, `rule = declaredTargetNs.error?.issues[0]?.message`, then `${rule}. ` — the no-trailing-period sentence composes correctly and `duplicatePackage` now carries the leading-letter rule with no change of its own. Its test reads the sentence off the schema (`protocol.duplicate-package-target-namespace.test.ts:102`); `git grep -F 'Namespace must be' refs/review/pr-19869 -- packages/metadata-protocol` → zero literal pins.

8. **Pins are weight-bearing — right.** `refs/review/pr-19869:packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.test.ts:678-718`: `1leave` / `_leave` must be one `invalid_format` issue whose message matches `/start with a lowercase letter/`, plus `/2-20 chars/` and `/lowercase letters, digits and underscores/`; the old sentence matches none of the three, so a revert fails. Lit control parses `leave`, `crm`, `my_app_2`, `a1`, a 20-char name on the field and inside a whole manifest. `package-namespace.test.ts:100` and `:228` retype the new sentence verbatim; `:160-175` reads the sentence off all four fields for `1leave` and holds them `toBe` the manifest's, which fails on any drift of `package.zod.ts`. The PR's firing-control runs were not re-run here (gate family); `Test Core (1/6..6/6)` and `TypeScript Type Check` at head: success.

9. **Drift on main since the PR base — right, nothing collides.** `git rev-list --count 0e90a8d1c5f3cd3312730a0c9d7f206b3e887314..origin/main` = 32 (origin/main `c1641868a3da71537c9c6c572d2bd2044103236b`); `git log 0e90a8d1c5..origin/main -- packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.zod.ts packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.test.ts packages/spec/src/marketplace/package.zod.ts packages/spec/src/marketplace/package-namespace.test.ts` → empty; `git diff 0e90a8d1c5 origin/main | grep -E 'lowercase alphanumeric \+ underscore|start with a lowercase letter|2-20 chars'` → zero. `git grep -F 'Namespace must be' origin/main` → only the four files this PR edits plus the 19577 changeset, so no new pin of the old sentence landed on main. `pulls/19869` `mergeable_state: clean`.

### ② Semver level

`refs/review/pr-19869:.changeset/manifest-namespace-leading-letter-refusal.md:2` `"@objectstack/spec": patch`, `:7` `Clause-②: no`, no arm. AGENTS.md at origin/main `:1081-1085`: a bug fix in a released package takes `patch`, never none and never `skip-changeset`; the declaration is `Clause-②: yes|no` plus at most one arm, and `yes` takes at least `minor`. The accept set is byte-identical (①.1), so `no` with no arm is the correct declaration; the built `dist/` carries a changed runtime string, so `skip-changeset` does not apply; nothing is removed or renamed, so no migration text and no ADR-0087 marker is owed (`:1086-1096`). `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` ships no changed bytes (①.7) and rides the `fixed` group plus `updateInternalDependencies: patch` in `origin/main:.changeset/config.json`. The PR body's `Clause-②: no` matches the changeset. `Check Changeset` check-run at head: success. Level and declaration agree: **patch, prose-only**.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Non-blocking — escalate to the `domain:spec` seat, and the stated mitigation does not hold.** `.changeset/19577-duplicate-package-explicit-namespace.md:15` (identical at `origin/main` and `refs/review/pr-19869`) quotes `Namespace must be 2-20 chars, lowercase alphanumeric + underscore` as the text `duplicatePackage` returns; after this PR the runtime never produces it. It is outside the amended claim (comment 5796198185 routes it through ruling D, #18375), so it is not a defect of this diff. But the amendment's and PR body's reasoning for option B — "PR 19869's own changeset ... so the CHANGELOG carries the correction next to that quote" — is false: that changeset is `'@objectstack/metadata-protocol': minor` (its line 2) and this PR's is `"@objectstack/spec": patch`; `changeset version` writes per-package files (`packages/metadata-protocol/CHANGELOG.md` and `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` both exist at origin/main), and the `fixed` group aligns versions, not text. At release `packages/metadata-protocol/CHANGELOG.md` would publish a refusal text that version never emits, with the correction in a different package's file, and AGENTS.md `:697` then makes it a released-entry amendment. The seat should amend that one line (dev's option A route, via the ruling-D path) before the release that consumes it. `scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs:605-610` names this exact "deliberate correction" class as the human path: say so on the PR and get it confirmed, which the PR's Acceptance notes do.
- **Non-blocking.** Changeset line 13 quotes the TSDoc `Rules:` line without its parenthetical `(`1leave` and `_leave` are refused)` present at `manifest.zod.ts:383`; a prefix of the real line, not a contradiction.
- **Non-blocking.** PR body says `origin/main` is 4 commits ahead at `2bbb462335`; at review it is 32 ahead at `c1641868a3`. ①.9 shows none of them touches this diff.
- **Non-blocking.** The changeset file name has no issue prefix; `scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs:598-599` recommends an issue-scoped name only as the collision remedy, no gate enforces it, and the slug is distinctive.
- **Non-blocking, acknowledged, out of scope of the claim.** Dev report 5796170355 `out_of_scope_findings`: the sibling `manifestIdRefusal` defect (same class on `manifest.id`, for the seat to file); the partial internal comment at `namespace-prefix.ts:17`; the stale path `cloud/package.zod.ts` at `packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts:86` (verified: the file lives at `marketplace/package.zod.ts`). None is this card's landing site.
- **Files vs amended claim: all five inside.** `pulls/19869/files`: `.changeset/manifest-namespace-leading-letter-refusal.md` (+16), `packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.test.ts` (+41, appended block only), `packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.zod.ts` (+3 -2, hunks at 379-393, the `namespace` key only; the `version` key and imports that PR #19637 edits are untouched), `packages/spec/src/marketplace/package-namespace.test.ts` (+19 -2) and `packages/spec/src/marketplace/package.zod.ts` (+6 -5), the last two per amendment 5796198185. No generated file moved; no file outside `packages/spec` or `.changeset/`.
- **Trailers.** Both commits (`48ea3d9960ad95ac1e90900455530b7c62aee8ac`, `27704f4cc2d7b6b06b17fcd053d330270345bf7d`) end with the model-free pair `Claude-Session:` and `Co-authored-by: Claude` required by AGENTS.md `:451-452`; the PR body and changeset carry no model identifier.
- **Checks.** `commits/27704f4cc2d7b6b06b17fcd053d330270345bf7d/check-runs`: `total_count: 35`, all `completed`, 32 `success`, 3 `skipped` (Console Pin Gate, Build Docs, Packed-tarball smoke opt-in), 0 failures. No gate family was re-run locally. The PR is still a draft with no `needs:contract-review` label; posting this record is the seat's act, not a defect.
